description: Configured per-tenant limits (ingestion rate/burst, series, retention, query limits, etc.) for Mimir, Loki and Tempo, per cluster.

options.content: These are the current platform-wide limits for ingestion and querying across Loki (logs), Mimir (metrics), and Tempo (traces). Values are sourced directly from the running services.
